scripts.install:all: npm install && cd gateway && npm install && cd ../stations && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.start:backend: concurrently -n "GATEWAY,STA-A,STA-B,STA-C" -c "magenta,green,blue,yellow" "npm run gateway" "npm run station:a" "npm run station:b" "npm run station:c"
scripts.start:all: concurrently -k -n "GATEWAY,STA-A,STA-B,STA-C,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,green,blue,yellow,cyan" "npm run gateway" "npm run station:a" "npm run station:b" "npm run station:c" "npm run frontend"
